heading: Our Portfolio
subheading: A selection of projects that showcase our expertise and real-world impact

items.title: Corporate Website & CMS
items.description: Modern, responsive corporate website with a Content Management System for publishing news, announcements, and career opportunities, plus an easy-to-use administration portal.

items.title: Customer Ordering Portal
items.description: Customer self-registration and online ordering with an approval workflow through an administration portal, seamlessly integrated with Infor ERP LN for order processing.

items.title: Vendor Self-Service Portal
items.description: Online vendor registration and document submission with automated approval workflow and one-click creation of Business Partner records in Infor ERP LN, eliminating manual data entry.

items.title: Dealer Portal
items.description: Dealer self-service ordering platform with real-time order tracking, sales process visibility, and improved collaboration between dealers and sales teams.

items.title: AI-Powered Recruitment Portal
items.description: AI-powered CV parsing to automatically populate candidate profiles, online vacancy publishing, end-to-end recruitment workflow including screening, interviews, approvals, job offers, onboarding, and automated email notifications.

items.title: Infor ERP LN Integration
items.description: Secure integration between all business applications and Infor ERP LN with automated data synchronization across customer, vendor, and recruitment processes, reducing manual effort and improving data accuracy.
